_note: Single source of truth for Texas Adult Driver Education (ADE-1317) marketing facts. Every number here traces to the Portal Handoff Spec or 16 TAC 84.503. Do not hand-edit values without updating the spec.

provider.deLicenseNumberNote: 16 TAC 84.503(j)(4): provider name + DRIVER EDUCATION license number must show on the site and through registration/payment. This is NOT CP#1234 (that is the driving-safety license and belongs only on /texas). Fill in after TDLR approval; the flag must stay off until then.
